{"consolidated_memory":"## Signature Mismatch in Key Rotation: Four Separate Incidents

**File:** crypto/keys/rotation.py (security side)

**Common pattern:** All four incidents manifested as verification failure against the previous key when rotating the signing key while requests are in flight. Each occurred under different trigger conditions and had a different root cause.

---

### Incident 1 [2026-02-26]
**Trigger:** Traffic arriving through corporate proxy
**Root cause:** Two writes in key rotation were not wrapped in a transaction
**Result:** Cold start dropped 18 percent to 360 ms
**Fix:** Wrapped both writes in one transaction
**PR/Branch:** PR #1503, branch fix/signature-mismatch-1

### Incident 2 [2026-03-03]
**Trigger:** Staging read replica
**Root cause:** Config loader reading wrong environment file
**Result:** 99 duplicate rows a day stopped being written
**Fix:** Made environment selection explicit and failed closed on ambiguity
**PR/Branch:** PR #2049, branch fix/signature-mismatch-2

### Incident 3 [2026-08-02]
**Trigger:** Input list came in empty
**Root cause:** Mutable default argument shared across calls
**Result:** p99 latency fell from 2.4 s to 583 ms
**Fix:** Made the default empty and built the value per call
**PR/Branch:** PR #3247, branch fix/signature-mismatch-3

### Incident 4 [2026-08-30]
**Trigger:** Jobs scheduled across the midnight boundary
**Root cause:** Race condition in lazy initialisation
**Result:** Flaky test went from 48 failures per hundred runs to zero
**Fix:** Guarded the init with a double-checked lock
**PR/Branch:** PR #3530, branch fix/signature-mismatch-4

---

**Context carried over:** All work occurred in the same corner of crypto/keys/rotation.py, so understanding from earlier incidents informed later work on the same problematic area."}
